text: For the leader; [1] with stringed instruments. A psalm of David.
I Answer me when I call, my saving God.When troubles hem me in, set me free;take pity on me, hear my prayer. [AA]
II How long, O people, will you be hard of heart?Why do you love what is worthless, chase after lies? [2] [AB]Selah
Know that the Lord works wonders for his faithful one;the Lord hears when I call out to him.
Tremble [3] and sin no more;weep bitterly [4] within your hearts,wail upon your beds, [AC]
Offer fitting sacrificesand trust in the Lord. [AD]
III Many say, "May we see better times!Lord, show us the light of your face!" [AE]Selah
But you have given my heart more joythan they have when grain and wine abound.
t[AF] [5]In peace I will lie down and fall asleep,for you alone, Lord, make me secure.
